build_normal_resize_compensate: build a transform that resizes depth and mask to match image dimensions using nearest interpolation
build_normal_crop: build a transform that randomly crops images, masks, and normal maps to a specified crop size
build_normal_resize: build a transform that resizes images, masks, and normal maps to fixed target width and height
build_normal_random_flip: build a transform that flips images and masks horizontally while negating the X component of normal vectors
build_pack_normal_inputs: build a transform that packs images and normal maps into SegDataSample tensors for model input
